wish: someone should make a LOGO interpreter that has a turtle
spec:
A LOGO interpreter with an animated turtle that draws on a canvas: FD, BK, RT, LT, PU, PD, SETXY, SETPC, ARC, REPEAT, IF, MAKE, variables, arithmetic and TO … END procedures with inputs and recursion.
Type a program, tap Run (or Ctrl+Enter), pick a speed, save the drawing as PNG; the program is remembered.
It does not do LOGO list processing, word primitives, multiple turtles or screen wrap.

type.text:
TO SQ :S
REPEAT 4 [FD :S RT 90]
END
SQ 60
RT 45 FD 20
